nodes.title: HOW TO USE
widgets_values:
ONE WORKFLOW FOR ALL PICTURES

1. MODEL: pick the AI (see list). TASK: new from text, or edit your picture.
2. PICTURE 1: click it, Ctrl+V your picture (edit tasks only).
   PICTURE 2 (optional): a 2nd picture - a style, an object, a face -
   set 'USE PICTURE 2?' true and name it in the text ("in the style of
   picture 2", "put the hat from picture 2 on him").
3. Type in WHAT YOU WANT / WHAT TO CHANGE.
4. Click Run. Result on the right + ComfyUI\output\ALL_IN_ONE.

PRECISE EDIT (change only one part, keep the rest pixel-exact):
  right-click PICTURE 1 > Open in MaskEditor, paint over the part,
  Save, set 'ONLY CHANGE PAINTED AREA?' true. EDGE = grow the area (px).
NEW CAMERA ANGLE (Qwen model only): set 'USE CAMERA ANGLE?' true and
  drag the camera. Leave the text empty or add an edit ("make it night").

SIZE: text tasks use SHAPE + megapixels; edit tasks keep your picture's
  shape, at EDIT SIZE megapixels. HOW MANY = versions per Run.
EDIT STRENGTH (Z-Image / SDXL edits only): 0.3 small change .. 0.8 big.
STYLE: each model has its own LoRA box; strength 0 = off.

Which model?  Qwen-Image 2.1 = smartest (long prompts, text, edits;
FULL QUALITY? true = 25 steps) but NON-COMMERCIAL licence - tests and
concepts only.  Z-Image = best looking from text.  Klein = fast, edits
like ChatGPT, style from picture 2.  Qwen Edit = most precise edits +
camera angles (slower).  SDXL = old LoRA styles only.
EDITS: use Klein or Qwen. Z-Image / SDXL cannot follow edit instructions,
they only redraw your picture (restyle) at EDIT STRENGTH.
Precise edit needs a picture WITHOUT a transparent background (transparent
areas count as painted).
